consequences: Manifest is least-privilege; README/CHANGELOG updated. Scope validation remains as pure-Lua defense-in-depth, now root-parameterized.
context: Bundled manifest declared panel.provider, panel.create, and [[capabilities.filesystem]] read+write; grep shows init.lua never calls a panel API or bitty.fs, and Plugin API v1 excludes bitty.ui.register_panel (post-v1.0) and bitty.fs (surface/bitty-plugin-api-v1.json exclusions).
decision_body: Remove all three phantom capability requests; keep only terminal.semantic-read, the sole surface exercised (bitty.terminal.snapshot). Re-add an fs.* grant only in a reviewed task once a host-mediated bitty.fs surface exists and code exercises it.
title: H-FM-02: file-manager manifest requests terminal.semantic-read only

consequences: tests/spec/scene_spec.lua became a regression guard that the module exposes no builders; run.lua/justfile/tests/README untouched because the file and suite remain.
context: lua/file-manager/scene.lua builders were never imported by init.lua; no accepted Plugin API v1 surface mounts a scene from a command result (bitty.ui.register_panel post-v1.0; bitty.ui.mount needs ui.rich, not requested).
decision_body: Delete all five builders (empty/file_rows/directory/preview/rename); scene.lua stays as an intentional empty placeholder with a one-line future-intent pointer. Follows git-panel CTX-0004 precedent (dead presenters deleted with a pointer).
title: M-FM-05: delete dead scene builders, keep empty placeholder

consequences: Arbitrary roots supported; a..b/backup..tar.gz admitted; x/../y denied. Tests updated to synthetic roots.
context: scope.lua hardcoded ~/projects/** and used a substring '..' check; the same scope problem was solved in git-panel via is_absolute_path/is_within_root/join_root.
decision_body: Mirror git-panel semantics: resolve absolute-or-relative candidates against a caller-supplied root (args.root > settings.root > cached cwd), validate containment segment-wise, reject only whole '..' segments, fail closed when no root exists. init.lua fails preview/rename with E_SCOPE_UNAVAILABLE and returns an empty open listing without a root.
title: M-FM-04: root-parameterized scope, no hardcoded prefix
